messages:
elena: Dropping follow-ups from the all-hands here. Ask anything about mission, positioning, market signals, or competitors. I'll respond during the afternoon.

marc: Quick from enablement  what's the 1-line for reps to open conversations with regulated customers?

zara: Also curious: are we updating the public positioning on cost vs performance this quarter?
oliver: tech question: can we point to a simple perf claim for p95 on common configs? reps ask for a number.
rina: GTM ask: any change to the % focus on Dedicated vs Hosted this year? a ballpark is fine.
elena: Answers: 1) Regulated customers opener: "Redwood: predictable SLAs, private deployment options, and the same developer API everywhere." Keep it short.
elena: 2) Positioning update: yes  we'll emphasize "serving economics" (cost per token + predictable latency) and compliance. New one-pager next week.
elena: 3) Simple perf claim for reps: "Typical p95 latency in our verified catalog ranges from ~80-200ms depending on model & hw; see internal battleground for details." We'll publish a tightened p95 table.
elena: 4) Focus split: Hosted stays top-of-funnel; target ~28% of new-logo ACV from Dedicated/Private this fiscal (internal target).

marc: thanks  that helps for the sales script.
zara: will the public docs call out hyperscalers by name or keep it product-first?
elena: Keep customer-facing messaging product-first. Internal enablement will include direct comparisons and "talking points".
oliver: follow-up: any short guidance for engineers on reducing latency long-context runs? cache vs quantization?
elena: Start with KV/prefix caching + batching; only add quantization if quality checks pass. We'll share a short perf playbook.
ops-bot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood/ah/1867003333
rina: perfect  thanks elena.
elena: I'll drop the one-pager and the roadmap excerpt by EOD. Keep questions coming. :raised_hands:
